QuestInfo.name: [Home] For a Warm and Happy Winter
QuestInfo.0:
#e[Home Maplemas]#n
It's the Maplemas season again! As the year comes to a close, it's time to look back on the happy memories we made with our Querencia neighbors. Go give Grandma Dona your holiday greetings.

#b[Event Period]#k
#R501185ExstartDateStrRef502617#
- #R501185ExendDateStrRef502617#

#b* Maplemas construction and furniture can only be acquired during the event period and can be used permanently after acquisition.
